question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: about

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the use of the given prepositions. 
 
 
• To is used as an infinitive of purpose to mean 'in order to'.
 
• Within is used to express that some stated time or less will pass before something happens.
 
• For is used with a period to say how long something goes on.
 
• About means 'on the subject of' something or 'concerning of' something/someone.
 
 
 
• As per the usage of the given prepositions about is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: **"He kept it a secret from his wife."**

Hence, the correct answer is: option 4.

Complete Paragraph: *In 1945, James Leach Miller returned from World War II and shared nothing **(1) about__** it with his wife. He folded up his Army (2)______, with the medals still pinned to it, and (3)______ put it in the basement, where his older boy would (4)______ take it out to play soldiers. He never complained (5)______ that generation of army men didn’t air their problems. His son Michael once offered to take him back to Normandy when World War II veterans (6)______ the journey but his father shook (7)______ head saying, “I’ve been there once.” Sadly, Mr. Miller, 96 years old, (8)______ survived the bloodiest battle of World War II, died of (9)______ from the coronavirus on March 30 (10)______ an Old Soldiers’ Home.*
